summary: Chat 1 Tablet candidate shard remains complete and handoff-ready. The two physical conflicts are TGT.CENSUS.TABLET.3B2FED34BC21B5C9FEEC.V1 and TGT.CENSUS.TABLET.850AD4CEF4CCD12BCD05.V1.

NDC canon and ID grammar, Field Manual, Factory Ledger Agent Gate, Visual Change Master Map, and Visual Core Contract are unchanged between the Chat 1 base and current main.

AGENTS.md plus the parallel README, chat prompts, interoperability contract, and vocabulary registry changed only to add the shared status-channel coordination protocol; no Tablet candidate vocabulary or authority semantics changed.
decisions: Reuse current Target Index and expanded Visual Control evidence; do not run broad rediscovery.
Use Atlasfin as priority visual reference but promote only evidence-backed recipe-level candidates; do not guess family or preset variants.
Do not inspect or fall back to the Surface Visual Governor Materiality Catalog; keep it STANDBY_USER_INVOKED_ONLY.
Preserve null/UNRESOLVED values where current machine authority is ambiguous; unknown stays unknown.
Do not mint canonical NDC, VIS, BND, TGT, LYR, Identity recipe/family/preset, or adapter IDs from the surface worker.
Treat lane output as candidate exchange data only, never as Work Entry authorization, GVAE receipt, runtime certification, or canonical authority.
Classify the base-to-current-main delta as coordination-only for Chat 1: no relevant source/authority drift requires candidate recomputation or broad rediscovery.
Keep state READY_FOR_INTEGRATION. Recompute only if a future change touches a recorded Chat 1 input authority or changes candidate semantics.
